title: Penelope Bourbon Rolls Out Cigar Sessions: Chapter 2, Crafted in Partnership with Alec Bradley Cigars
summary: ST. LOUIS, September 10, 2026--Penelope Bourbon is taking its annual Cigar Sessions series to a bolder place with the release of Cigar Sessions: Chapter 2, a high-proof American whiskey crafted in collaboration with renowned cigar-makers Alec Bradley. The new expression brings together Penelope’s blending expertise and Alec Bradley’s decades of cigar-making experience to create a whiskey specifically designed to complement medium to full-bodied cigars.
